name: job-hunt
description: An honest, mostly hands-off job search: finds openings twice a day across thousands of company job boards, job aggregators, Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Dice and your LinkedIn and other job alerts, applies with a resume tailored to each posting and checked against your verified dossier, preps one-minute apply kits for LinkedIn Easy Apply-only jobs, reads your email to keep the tracker current, and reviews what's working every week.
